other_conditions: Eligibility includes fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fish vendors, fisheries development corporations, SHGs/JLGs in the fisheries sector, fisheries cooperatives, fisheries federations, entrepreneurs and private firms, fish farmer producer organisations/companies, SC/ST/Women/Differently Abled persons, state governments/UTs and their entities, state fisheries development boards, and central government and its entities
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for fishing infrastructure, fish farming activities, fisheries management, credit‑linked subsidies, and marketing/export support.
